zh.title: 澳洲航空啟動機隊換裝：以空中巴士A321XLR飛機汰換波音737-800
zh.summary: 澳洲航空在「溫頓計畫」機隊更新下以空中巴士A321XLR汰換波音737-800，訂單共48架，首批737退役已展開；預估2027年起每年可為獲利增加1.5億至2億澳元。
body: 澳洲航空在機隊更新計畫「溫頓計畫」下，以空中巴士A321XLR汰換波音737-800，做為國內線高運量主力機型；該計畫名稱取自澳洲航空1920年創立地昆士蘭州溫頓。737機隊每年載運近半數澳航旅客，換裝將牽動澳洲最繁忙的國內幹線。A321XLR訂單從最初至少20架增至28架，澳洲航空2025年8月再增訂20架，總數達48架；澳航已在2026財政年度接收6架A321XLR，737退役自2026年底展開。

澳洲航空已簽署七年協議，將44架737-800與88具CFM56-7B發動機售予AerFin，首批飛機已於2026年底開始退出，2027年另有9架計畫退役，部分留用的737-800則預計自2027年起進行客艙翻新。以A321XLR與A220-300汰換737-800，預估2027年起每年可為獲利增加1.5億至2億澳元。A321XLR航程最遠達5400哩（8700公里），較737多約1864哩（3000公里），讓澳航得以在繁忙國內幹線與布里斯本—馬尼拉等區域國際航線彈性調度同一機型。

客艙與時程方面，早期國內線構型A321XLR設197或200席，含20席可傾斜商務艙座椅；16架預計2028年起交付的飛機將配備附滑門的平躺商務艙套房與19吋（48公分）螢幕。早期交付的飛機曾因經濟艙洗手間比例受質疑，澳航已增設第三間經濟艙洗手間，自第四架起座位數減少3席，並計畫為最早的飛機改裝。A321XLR國際首航布里斯本—馬尼拉已由2026年10月25日延至2027年2月1日，期間由空中巴士A330-200執飛。澳洲航空集團執行長Vanessa Hudson強調，額外航程讓航空公司得以飛抵現有窄體機隊無法服務的目的地。

en.title: Qantas to replace Boeing 737-800s with Airbus A321XLRs under Project Winton
en.summary: Qantas is replacing its Boeing 737-800s with Airbus A321XLRs under its Project Winton fleet renewal program, with 48 of the long-range narrowbodies on order and the first retirements under way; the switch is projected to add AUD 150–200 million a year to earnings by 2027.
body: Qantas is replacing its Boeing 737-800s with the Airbus A321XLR as its main high-capacity domestic replacement under Project Winton, its fleet renewal program named for Winton, Queensland, where Qantas was founded in 1920. The 737 fleet carries nearly half of all passengers Qantas flies each year, so the change affects its busiest domestic corridors. The A321XLR order grew from an initial plan for at least 20 aircraft to 28, and Qantas ordered 20 more in August 2025, bringing the total to 48. Qantas took six A321XLRs during its 2026 financial year, ahead of 737 retirements beginning in late 2026.

Qantas has signed a seven-year agreement to sell 44 737-800s and 88 CFM56-7B engines to AerFin, with initial aircraft exits already under way in late 2026 and nine more retirements planned for 2027; select remaining 737-800s are slated for cabin refurbishments from 2027. Replacing 737-800s with A321XLRs and A220-300s is projected to add between AUD 150 million and AUD 200 million per year to earnings by 2027. The A321XLR offers up to 5,400 miles (8,700 km) of range, roughly 1,864 miles (3,000 km) farther than the 737, giving Qantas flexibility to use the same type on busy domestic trunk routes and selected regional international routes such as the scheduled Brisbane–Manila service.

On cabins and timing, early domestic-configured A321XLRs carry 197 or 200 seats, including 20 recliner business seats, while 16 aircraft due from 2028 will have lie-flat business suites with sliding doors and 19-inch (48 cm) screens. Early deliveries drew scrutiny over economy washroom ratios before Qantas added a third economy lavatory, trimming the seat count by three seats from the fourth aircraft onward and planning retrofits for the earliest jets. The A321XLR's international debut on Brisbane–Manila moved from October 25, 2026 to February 1, 2027, with Airbus A330-200s covering the route in the meantime. Qantas Group CEO Vanessa Hudson has emphasized that the extra range gives the airline flexibility to reach destinations its current narrowbody fleet cannot.
